rules.qualitySource: The approved 78 mL or 128 mL Round master
rules.fitmentRule: Preserve the exact SKU fitment. Standard perfume sprayers are one-step; matte-silver lotion pumps retain their separate two-step geometry.
rules.materialRule: Clear and frosted glass retain their actual material identity while adopting the approved premium edge refraction, optical base, and tight grounded contact shadow.
rules.integrationRule: Candidate review is required before catalog replacement. Final placement uses deterministic scale and position only.

masters.notes: Preferred first 78 mL render; approved glass fidelity and accurate one-step copper spray fitment.
Approved 128 mL render; approximately 14 percent greater visual body presence and accurate one-step matte-gold spray fitment.

alignedCollection.method: Uniform scale and translation of the complete raster assembly; glass body radius sets scale and the glass base sets the 91 percent baseline.
alignedCollection.backgroundNormalization: Only the matte connected to the canvas edge is normalized to exact #F5F3EF; bottle, fitment, refraction, and contact-shadow pixels remain protected.

superseded.reason: The later actuator edit was less faithful than the selected first 78 mL render.
